title: Glean needs more than documents
body: Open each data family. A connector that brings only one of them delivers a weaker experience.

hotspots.label: Content
hotspots.detail: Items and their metadata. If a result has no body text, users can find it, but Assistant cannot summarize it.

hotspots.label: People and identity
hotspots.detail: Glean aligns identities across systems, so authorship and permissions resolve to the right person.

hotspots.label: Activity
hotspots.detail: Creation, modification, viewing, and sharing timestamps and users. Signals such as views, edits, and shares rank results by relevance.

hotspots.label: Freshness
hotspots.detail: Connectors capture changes as quickly as the source and connector allow, often through webhooks or incremental crawling.
